description: The same relative-note patterns play under C major (scale slot 1) for bars 1 and 2 and D major (scale slot 2) for bars 3 and 4, at 90 BPM. Doubledecker on channel 1 plays degrees 0, 0, 0 and 1 on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13, with the last note softer (velocity 50): MIDI 60, 60, 60, 62 in C and 62, 62, 62, 64 in D. Polyperc 1 on channel 2 plays degrees 0 and 4 at octave minus 1 on steps 1 and 9: MIDI 48 and 55 in C and 50 and 57 in D. Note masks stay X, and rhythm and velocity do not change. Listen for the whole texture stepping up a whole tone at bar 3. Build it with the Make the relative-note scale comparison recipe.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Changing Harmony with Scale Slots
